races.verdict: Andrew Balding's OLD IS GOLD has proved a different model since the visor went on and this front runner can make light of a 9 lb weights hike for his easy Newmarket success and complete a quick hat-trick. Ayr Gold Cup hero Pellitory continues in fine form and heads a long list of dangers with last year's winner Binhareer also a likely player. Coul Angel , Fine Interview , Toyotomi and Grasmere Boy all command plenty of respect too in this cracking sprint. OLD IS GOLD (IRE) PELLITORY BINHAREER (IRE)
